caption: Castello di Avio, Avio
composition: Elongated hillside castle with curtain walls and keep above the Adige valley · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From across the valley, the tourist faces the Castello di Avio sprawling along its hilltop, the long curtain walls descending diagonally with the tall keep and tower rising right of center. The patchwork fields of the Adige valley spread to the left under hazy blue mountains, while dark forest covers the slopes to the right. The 13:20 sun is bright and high under a clear sky, picking out every stone of the ramparts.
